General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 1) Which company in Bangladesh gets approval of BSEC to issue the first Sukuk bond?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission (BSEC) এর অনুমোদন সাপেক্ষে, বেসরকারি পর্যায়ে প্রথম সুকুক বন্ড ছাড়ার অনুমোদন পায় - বেক্সিমকো লিমিটেড।
উৎস: Live MCQ সাম্প্রতিক সমাচার

বৈশ্বিক সাইবার নিরাপত্তা সূচকে বাংলাদেশের অবস্থান - ৫৩তম।
উৎস: Live MCQ সাম্প্রতিক সমাচার

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
জাতিসংঘের বাণিজ্য ও উন্নয়ন বিষয়ক সংস্থার ‘World Investment Report 2021’ অনুযায়ী বাংলাদেশে বিনিয়োগে শীর্ষ দেশ (মি. মা. ড.) - নেদারল্যান্ডস (৪০০.২১)।

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
কোরিয়ান ভাষায় ‘অসমাপ্ত আত্মজীবনী’ বইটির অনুবাদ করেন - লি ডং হিউন।
উৎস: Live MCQ সাম্প্রতিক সমাচার

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 5) Which company is allowed by BSEC to raise Tk 150 crore as a green bond?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
বাংলাদেশ সিকিউরিটিজ অ্যান্ড এক্সচেঞ্জ কমিশন (BSEC) প্রাণ এগ্রোকে দেশের দ্বিতীয় গ্রিন বন্ড হিসেবে ১৫০ কোটি টাকা তোলার অনুমতি দেয় - ৭ জুলাই, ২০২১।
উৎস: Live MCQ সাম্প্রতিক সমাচার

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 6) ‘Bashan Char Island’ is located in -
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
Bashan Char Island, which was seen in the news, is located in Hatiya Upazila, Bangladesh.
The Bangladesh government started the process of relocating the Rohingyas from Cox’s Bazar refugee camp to the newly developed facility at the Bhashan char Island. Bangladesh constructed shelter houses for Rohingya refugees at an estimated cost of 2,300 crore takas.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 7) Bagram air-base is located in -
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
বাগরাম বিমানঘাঁটির অবস্থান - আফগানিস্তানে।
উৎস: Live MCQ সাম্প্রতিক সমাচার

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 8) Which country lifted 93 million people out of poverty since 2013 and has announced eradication of extreme poverty in its country recently?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
China has removed the last remaining counties (regions) from a list of 832 extremely poor regions, drawn up in the year 2014.
China also announced that it has lifted 93 million people out of poverty since 2013. China sets its own national standard of extreme poverty, based on a per capita income threshold of 4,000 yuan per year, or around USD 1.52 per day, and other social factors.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 9) Who is the current Prime Minister of Malaysia?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
Malaysia's king appointed Ismail Sabri Yaakob as the prime minister on 20th Aug, 2021, replacing Muhyiddin Yassin, who stepped down after losing his parliamentary majority.
Source: Al Jajeera News Report.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 10) Which country has approved a three-child policy and has marked a major policy shift to prevent a steep decline in the birth rate in the country?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp: China has finally approved a three-child policy and has marked a major policy shift to prevent a steep decline in the birth rate in the country.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 11) Where is the headquarters of the World Conservation Monitoring Centre (WCMC)?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
The World Conservation Monitoring Centre (WCMC) is an agency of the UN Environment Programme (UNEP) which is headquartered at Cambridge in the United Kingdom.
The UNEP has recently released a report at Nairobi which is co-authored by the World Conservation Monitoring Centre. The report highlights that climate change and biodiversity loss are the twin crises that should be targeted with an integrated approach.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 12) Which country has confirmed the first case of the contagious Marburg virus?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
On 6 August 2021, the Ministry of Health of Guinea informed WHO of a confirmed case of Marburg virus disease (MVD) in Guéckédou Prefecture, Nzérékoré Region, south-western Guinea.
The village where the case resided is near both Sierra Leone and Liberian borders. This is the first known case of Marburg virus disease in Guinea and in West Africa.
Marburg virus ১৯৬৭ সালে জার্মানি ও সার্বিয়াতে দেখা দিয়েছিলো। এটি ইবোলা গোত্রের ভয়ংকর সংক্রামক একটি ভাইরাস।

উৎসঃ বিশ্ব স্বাস্থ্য সংস্থার ওয়েবসাইট।

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 13) The ‘Sinatra Doctrine’, which was making news recently, has been adopted by which international association?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
The European Union has recently adopted the ‘Sinatra Doctrine’. The Central and Eastern Europe (CEE) member countries have accepted the doctrine.
The doctrine includes continuing cooperation with China in addressing global challenges such as climate change, COVID-19, while strengthening the EU’s sovereignty by protecting technological sectors of its economy.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 14) Which country has recently issued commemorative envelopes and special stamps commemorating the birth centenary of Bangabandhu?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
বঙ্গবন্ধুর জন্মশতবার্ষিকীর স্মরণে স্মারক খাম ও বিশেষ ডাকটিকেট অবমুক্ত করে - ফিলিপাইনের পোস্টাল কর্পোরেশন ‘ফিলপোস্ট’ (৯ জুলাই, ২০২১)।
উৎস: Live MCQ সাম্প্রতিক সমাচার

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 15) The European Union has imposed a fine of $886.6 million on which online shop?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp: The European Union has imposed a fine of $886.6 million or 746 million euro on Amazon.com Inc. The European Union fined Amazon for processing personal data in violation of EU's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: ১৬) Which country has launched its ‘Flash Flood Guidance’ system to provide forecasting services to South-Asian countries?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
India has launched ‘Flash Flood Guidance’ services for itself and other South Asian countries including Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal, and Sri Lanka, to provide impact-based forecasting.
The Flash Flood Guidance system has been designed by the India Meteorological Department (IMD), to provide forecasting of flash floods which occur at short duration. The services are provided at watershed and city level.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 17) The 2021 edition of the World Athletics U20 Championships has been started in which country?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp: The 2021 edition of the World Athletics U20 Championships has been started in Nairobi, Kenya.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 18) ‘Starship’, is the rocket-ship of which space company/organization?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
Starship is the futuristic rocket-ship of SpaceX, the private space company owned by billionaire Elon Musk. It is being designed to carry people to Mars.
The first high-altitude test flight of the Starship was aborted at the last second, due to an automatic engine abort just ahead of the count-down. SpaceX has conducted five Starship test flights but not at high altitude.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 19) According to the report of the UNCTAD on June 21, 2021, Foreign Direct Investment in Bangladesh -
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
২১ জুন, ২০২১ জাতিসংঘের বাণিজ্য ও উন্নয়ন বিষয়ক সংস্থা (UNCTAD) ‘World Investment Report 2021’ রিপোর্ট প্রকাশ করে।
রিপোর্ট অনুযায়ী, বাংলাদেশে সরাসরি বৈদেশিক বিনিয়োগ (FDI) হয়: ২,৫৬৪ মিলিয়ন মার্কিন ডলার।
উৎস: Live MCQ সাম্প্রতিক সমাচার

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 20) Hakainde Hichilema has won the presidential election of which country?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp: The opposition leader in Zambia Hakainde Hichilema has won the country's Presidential elections over incumbent President Edgar Lungu.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 21) Which country has recently banned China’s Huawei and ZTE in its 5G network?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
The use of telecom equipment from China’s Huawei and ZTE for the 5G network has been banned by Sweden on security grounds. This announcement comes ahead of the spectrum auction scheduled for next month in the country.
The decision has been made in accordance to the advice rendered by the country’s armed forces which has described China as a biggest security threat to Sweden.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 22) Bangladesh Bank issued first Shariah-based Islamic bonds in -
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
বাংলাদেশ ব্যাংক প্রথম শরিয়াহভিত্তিক ইসলামী বন্ড ইস্যু করে - ২৮ ডিসেম্বর ২০২০।
উৎস: Live MCQ সাম্প্রতিক সমাচার

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 23) Which country has ended the ''virginity tests'' on female cadets?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp: The Indonesian Army ended the ''virginity tests'' on female cadets which the World Health Organization determined has ''no scientific merit or clinical indication'' involves someone placing their fingers into a cadet's vagina to supposedly assess whether they have had sex.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 24) Which country has recently test-fired a surface to surface nuclear-capable ballistic missile called Ghaznavi?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp: Pakistan successfully test-fired a surface to surface nuclear-capable ballistic missile called Ghaznavi on 12th August.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 25) What is the name of the Moon-landing Mission of NASA, for which it has chosen the first-ever woman?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
NASA has named the 18 astronauts group, half of them being women, who will train for its Moon-landing Mission by 2024, named ‘Artemis’.
From this set of astronauts, the first woman to set foot on the moon and the next man on the moon will be picked up.
The group includes Christina Koch and Jessica Meir, who performed the world’s first all-female spacewalk.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 26) Johnson and Johnson vaccine that has been approved in Bangladesh, belongs to which country?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp: Johnson and Johnson's vaccine has been approved in Bangladesh. The company belongs to the USA.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 27) Which two countries have joined the coalition on Disaster Resilient Infrastructure?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp: Bangladesh and Canada have joined a coalition on Disaster Resilient Infrastructure.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 28) Ebrahim Raisi was sworn in as the new president of which country?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp: Ebrahim Raisi was officially sworn in as the new president of Iran on August 05, 2021.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 29) Bangladesh ranked in the world in terms of foreign exchange reserves is:
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
বৈদেশিক মুদ্রার রিজার্ভের দিক থেকে বিশ্বে বাংলাদেশের অবস্থান ৪৪ তম।
উৎস: Live MCQ সাম্প্রতিক সমাচার

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 30) Which country has approved its first arms sales worth USD 750 million to Taiwan?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp: The US State Department on August 4, 2021, approved its first arms sales worth USD 750 million to Taiwan amid rising tensions with China.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 31) The First G-20 Cultural Ministers meeting was held in which country?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp: The First G-20 Cultural Ministers meeting was held in July 2021 virtually in Rome, Italy.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 32) Who has been re-appointed as the prime minister of Armenia?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp: Nikol Pashinyan has been re-appointed as the prime minister of Armenia by President Armen Sarkissian on August 02, 2021.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 33) Lamont Marcell Jacobs, who won Olympic gold in the men's 100 meters sprint, belongs to which country?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp: Italy's Lamont Marcell Jacobs outshone a field of unusual suspects to claim a shock Olympic gold in the men's 100 meters, breaking retired Jamaican star Usain Bolt's 13-year hold on the blue-riband event.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: ৩৪) Which Asian country recently took over the Presidency of the UN Security Council?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp: India took over the Presidency of the UN Security Council on August 1, 2021. The country assumed the rotational presidency of the 15 nation UNSC from France.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 35) Who has become the new Prime Minister of Myanmar?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp: Military ruler Gen. Min Aung Hlaing has become Prime Minister in the newly formed caretaker govt. in Myanmar.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 36) Which city will host the Olympic Games (Summer) of 2024?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
- ২০২০ সালের গ্রীষ্মকালীন অলিম্পিক গেমস অনুষ্ঠিত হয় - জাপানের টোকিওতে।
- ২০২৪ সালের গ্রীষ্মকালীন অলিম্পিক গেমস অনুষ্ঠিত হবে - ফ্রান্সের প্যারিসে।
সূত্রঃ অলিম্পিক গেমস ওয়েবসাইট।

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 37) Rodrigo Duterte is the president of -
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
Rodrigo Duterte is the current president of Philippines.
Recently he fully restores key defense pact on the presence of US troops.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 38) Which tech giant company has started business with VAT registration in Bangladesh?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
অনাবাসী প্রতিষ্ঠান হিসেবে বিশ্বের শীর্ষ চার টেক জায়ান্ট (গুগল, অ্যামাজন, ফেসবুক এবং মাইক্রোসফট) বাংলাদেশে ভ্যাট নিবন্ধন নিয়ে ব্যবসা শুরু করেছে।
২৩ মে, ২০২১ গুগল প্রথম প্রতিষ্ঠান হিসাবে ভ্যাটের ‘ব্যবসায় শনাক্তকরণ নম্বর’ (BIN) নেয়।
উৎস: Live MCQ সাম্প্রতিক সমাচার

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 39) Which country has banned cotton imports from China citing ‘slave labour’?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
The United States has issued an order to ban the cotton and cotton products from the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps (XPCC), one of the largest producers of China.
The U.S. Customs and Border Protection agency issued “Withhold Release Order” to increase economic pressure on the Xinjiang region. US cites the reason for the ban as ‘slave labour’ of detained Uighur Muslims used by China.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 40) Which country's Shehroze Kashif becomes the world's youngest mountaineer to scale K2?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp: Pakistan's 19-year-old Shehroze Kashif becomes the world's youngest mountaineer to scale K2 (8611 m) - the world's 2nd highest peak.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 41) Who has recently joined UNDP, Bangladesh as Country Economist?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
Nazneen Ahmed has joined the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), Dhaka Office as the Country Economist.
She will provide policy and strategic advice on various activities of UNDP Bangladesh aimed at sustainable development.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 42) Which Bangladeshi has conferred the Ramon Magsaysay Award 2021?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
Bangladeshi scientist Dr Firdausi Qadri, who has been instrumental in developing vaccines that have saved millions of lives, has been honoured with the Ramon Magsaysay Award, regarded as Asia's equivalent to Nobel Prize.

Dr Qadri is an emeritus scientist at the Mucosal Immunology and Vaccinology Unit at the Infectious Diseases Division of International Centre for Diarrhoeal Disease and Research, Bangladesh (icddr,b).


Source: Ramon Magsaysay Award Website and The Daily Star Report.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 43) Which country has joined AIIB as last full facilated member?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
চীনের বিশ্বব্যাংক হিসাবে খ্যাত 'এশিয়ান অবকাঠামো বিনিয়োগ ব্যাংক' (AIIB) ২০১৬ সালে ৫৭টি পূর্ণাঙ্গ সদস্য নিয়ে কার্যক্রম শুরু করলেও ২০২১ সালের আগস্ট পর্যন্ত পূর্ণাঙ্গ সদস্য দাড়িয়েছে - ৮৭টি। তার মধ্যে এশিয়ান দেশ - ৪৬টি এবং এশিয়ার বাইরের দেশ - ৪১টি।
- সদস্য সংখ্যা - ৮৭টি (পূর্ণাঙ্গ)
- সর্বশেষ সদস্য - চিলি (২ জুলাই, ২০২১)
- সম্ভাব্য সদস্য - ১৭টি
তথ্যসূত্রঃ AIIB website.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 44) Which country has passed the “No Ban Act / Bill”?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
The House of Representatives of the United States of America (USA) has recently passed the “No Ban Act”.
This bill aims to limit the ability of any United States president to impose a travel ban on the basis of religion. This move has been welcomed by many activists across the globe. Earlier, the US administration headed by President Donald Trump imposed “Muslim Ban” that barred travel to the US from several Muslim-majority countries.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 45) Which country has recently passed a legislation to legalise ‘Euthanasia’?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
Spain’s parliament passed a law legalising euthanasia, thereby becoming one of the few nations to allow euthanasia or assisted suicide to terminally-ill or gravely-injured patients.
The vote makes Spain the fourth European nation to decriminalise assisted suicide, besides the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 46) Which Middle-East country has recently introduced first female astronaut to its space program?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
The United Arab Emirates has named the next two astronauts for its space program. The ruler of Dubai Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum has named Noura al-Matroushi as the UAE’s first female astronaut.
The two astronauts have been identified among more than 4000 applications received. The two astronauts will undergo special space training at NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 47) Which programme is being piloted by the BTRC for the registration of mobile handsets?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
দেশে ব্যবহৃত মোবাইল হ্যান্ডসেট নিবন্ধনে টেলিযোগাযোগ নিয়ন্ত্রণ কমিশন (BTRC) পরীক্ষামূলকভাবে চালু করে - National Equipment Identity Register (NEIR) কার্যক্রম।
উৎস: Live MCQ সাম্প্রতিক সমাচার

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 48) Which country is named first in military expenses on Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI)'s fact sheet?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
বৈশ্বিক সামরিক ব্যয় সূচক - ২০২১
২৬ এপ্রিল, ২০২১ Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI) বৈশ্বিক সামরিক ব্যয় সংক্রান্ত ‘SIPRI Fact Sheet April 2021: Trends in world military expenditure, 2020’ শীর্ষক প্রতিবেদন প্রকাশ করে।
প্রতিবেদন অনুসারে, সামরিক খাতে বৈশ্বিক ব্যয় - ১৯৮১ বিলিয়ন মার্কিন ডলার।
- শীর্ষ দেশ - যুক্তরাষ্ট্র ( মোট ব্যয়ের পরিমাণ - ৭৭৮ বিলিয়ন ডলার যা বিশ্বের মোট সামরিক ব্যয়ের ৩৯%)
- দ্বিতীয় শীর্ষ দেশ - চীন (মোট ব্যয়ের পরিমাণ - ২৫২ বিলিয়ন ডলার যা বিশ্বের মোট সামরিক ব্যয়ের ১৩%)

তথ্যসূত্রঃ SIPRI Website.

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 49) The amount of deposits in the Swiss Bank by Bangladeshi citizens as recently reported by the Swiss Central Bank is around ______
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
Deposits in Swiss banks by Bangladeshi nationals and entities declined by 8.23 per cent to CHF (Swiss Franc) 562.86 million in 2020, according to latest data.
The Bangladesh-linked money, considered as deposits, was CHF 603.02 million in 2019.
The annual report of the Swiss National Bank or SNB titled 'Annual banking statistics for 2020' released in Zurich on Thursday unveiled the latest figures.
At the average rate of Tk 93.50 per CHF, the figures stand at Tk 52.63 billion (5263 Crore Taka) in 2020 and Tk 56.38 billion in the previous year.
Source: Thefinancialexpress.com.bd & Thedailystar.net

General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.question: 50) ‘Bangla Bond’ has been issued in which of the following countries?
General Knowledge - Recent Affairs.exp:
- Gamechanger -- is what best describes the debut of Bangla Bond, a taka-denominated debt instrument, on the London Stock Exchange on November 11 for Bangladesh.
- A brainchild of the International Finance Corporation, the private sector arm of the World Bank Group, the Bangla Bond not only brought onboard a new set of foreign investors but was also an acid test for the Bangladesh growth story on the global stage.
Source: The Daily Star.
